source.name: The Inner Ring - Women's Pro Team Sponsors Explained
source.quote: Movistar is the Spanish telecoms operate Telefonica and its mobile brand
source.note: The Inner Ring's Tour de France Femmes review names Movistar, Telefónica's mobile brand, as the team's sponsor; the team title is mapped to the front placement per the league's convention (data/leagues/uci-womens-worldtour.json). Telefónica's president said at the 2026 kit presentation: 'Each cyclist carries the M of Movistar on their jersey' (GOBIK pressroom, 11 December 2025).

source.name: GOBIK pressroom: 'Movistar Team presents its 2026 project with a renewed identity and a real commitment to the future of cycling'
source.quote: The event also served to unveil the new jersey designed by GOBIK
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The presentation covered the men's, women's and development squads together.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam. Movistar (Telefónica's commercial brand) carries the team name on the front of the mostly white jersey unveiled on 11 December 2025; the kit is made by GOBIK. Movistar is on hold as being-rated; other jersey placements (sleeves, back, shorts) could not be verified from text sources.
